notes.title: Hotfix - May 19, 2017
notes.notes:
We have recently pushed out an update that hopefully addresses 90-95% of bugs reported by the community and adds some additional functionality to the launcher.

There is a thread in the community hub that details some of the development progress we've been addressing these past couple of weeks. 

We hope to re-enable purchases soon

notes.title: May 3, 2017 - HotFix
notes.notes:
Day 1 Update

Through the course of the day we have issued a few hot patches and are continuing to fix items as we become aware of them.  Although we are working diligently on them, we do need to apologize for not being proactive on that front but we do appreciate the feedback in the community section.

    Fixed a soundtrack issue of tracks missing.  This was due to a bad upload to Steam.  A single track however is not playing and the reasons are being investigated.

    Soundtrack MP3s were updated as well, restoring missing files for the XG2 PC version. 

    Launcher was updated with controller support for big picture mode users.

    Launcher was also updated blocking resolutions higher than 1440p (QHD).  Unfortunately, this is a patch scenario while we investigate some of the graphical glitches and problems happening beyond QHD.  We hope to restore additional resolutions quickly and add some additional aspect ratio support.

We will keep the community apprised as rollouts take place.  Thank you.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27845473/1598b8909cb147802e13a3af8b4623a0d1f0e891.png
